schema: CREATE TABLE items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_name VARCHAR(100));
CREATE TABLE orders (item_id INT, rep_id INT, cust_id INT, order_date DATE, qty INT, total INT, FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES items(item_id));
correct_query: SELECT I.ITEM_ID, I.ITEM_NAME FROM items I INNER JOIN (SELECT ITEM_ID FROM orders GROUP BY ITEM_ID HAVING MIN(ORDER_DATE) >= '2020-01-01' AND MAX(ORDER_DATE) <= '2020-06-30') O ON I.ITEM_ID = O.ITEM_ID

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT DISTINCT I.ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME FROM items I JOIN orders O ON I.ITEM_ID = O.ITEM_ID WHERE ORDER_DATE BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-06-30' AND I.ITEM_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID FROM orders WHERE ORDER_DATE < '2020-01-01' OR ORDER_DATE > '2020-06-30')
